title.narrative: Women workers in Guangdong Province in China have better access to employment and career development Aligned with UN Women Strategic Plan Outcomes 1, 4, 5 and 6, contributing to Thematic Area 2: Womens Economic Empowerment

description.narrative: Women workers in Guangdong Province in China have better access to employment and career development Aligned with UN Women Strategic Plan Outcomes 1, 4, 5 and 6, contributing to Thematic Area 2: Womens Economic Empowerment

title.narrative: Indicator 1.1: % of participating employers/ industries with mechanism(s) in place supporting women workers career development

description.narrative: Mechanisms refer to policies and practices aimed at supporting womens career development and may include, 1) organize regular meetings with women workers to know their challenges, feedback and suggestions; 2) establish organigram of the workplace to monitor and follow the career path of workers (current positions, applications for senior positions, successful promotion/contract upgrade); 3) review general employment conditions for alignment with the relevant laws, such as recruitment practices, addressing gender bias, equal pay for equal work, representation in companies or factories, disaggregated statistic data, etc.; 4) set up concrete measures for PSEA; 5) consider flexible working arrangement (such as sick leave, pregnancy support, maternal/paternal leave and childcare support, family care issues, etc.); 6) setup or facilitate access to childcare services close to employment, afterschool care, or care during summer/winter vacation for migrant children, including seeking cooperation partners to pilot such service provision in/near the workplace); 7) facilitate access to mental health and counselling services, such as access to social work services, healthy lifestyles, etc. when needed.
